intents.description: Soil and agriculture intelligence for grower, agronomist and farming agents at any lat/lon. Returns live soil moisture at four depths, soil temperature at 0/6/18/54 cm, reference evapotranspiration (ET0), vapour pressure deficit and frost risk. For irrigation scheduling, soil-health monitoring and crop management.

intents.name: get_weather_tides
intents.description: Tide predictions and sea-level forecast for any coastal location: hourly sea-level height (meters) plus derived high and low tide times, next 24 hours by default. From Open-Meteo Marine. For shipping, fishing, surfing, and coastal or port operations that need tide tables.

intents.name: get_company_resolve
intents.description: Entity resolution for KYC/KYB, supplier and customer onboarding and France 2026 e-invoicing: use when you hold a company name, brand or director and need a certain identifier. Returns the French SIREN, EU VAT or global LEI with a confidence score and ranked candidates, cross-checked across official registers (recherche-entreprises Sirene/RNE, GLEIF LEI, EU VIES VAT). Input: name or vat, optional country, director, city.

intents.name: get_company_lookup
intents.description: Unified company lookup by exact identifier: one call, one normalized schema across French SIREN (recherche-entreprises Sirene/RNE), EU VAT (VIES validation), and global LEI (GLEIF). Returns legal name, status, address, activity code, officers, and full provenance (source, retrieval time, license). No per-register API-key signup — pay once, get consistent company data for e-invoicing, procurement, and compliance. Input: id + id_type (siren | vat | lei).

intents.name: get_crypto_price
intents.description: Real-time crypto token spot prices for AI agents and trading bots. Returns USD price, token symbol, and DefiLlama price confidence per coin. Query by DefiLlama coin key (coingecko:ethereum) or common ticker (btc, eth, sol, usdc, usdt) — batch up to 50 coins in one call. Keyless, unified schema, stablecoin-payable.

intents.name: get_crypto_market
intents.description: Crypto market data for AI agents: market capitalization, 24-hour trading volume, 24h percent change, circulating and total supply, and market-cap rank for any coin. Query by Coinpaprika id (btc-bitcoin) or common ticker (btc, eth, sol). One call, USD-denominated, keyless.

intents.name: get_defi_tvl
intents.description: DeFi TVL (total value locked) for AI agents. Query a single protocol by slug (aave, uniswap, lido) for its current USD TVL, a specific chain by name, or omit both for the top 20 chains ranked by TVL. Sourced from DefiLlama — on-chain liquidity and DeFi health signal in USD.

intents.name: get_defi_yields
intents.description: DeFi yield and APY data for AI agents and yield optimizers. Thousands of liquidity and lending pools across chains and protocols, filterable by chain, project, token symbol, minimum TVL and stablecoin-only, sorted by APY. Each pool returns chain, project, symbol, TVL and APY. Sourced from DefiLlama yields.

intents.name: get_crypto_bundle
intents.description: Complete crypto and DeFi snapshot in ONE call for AI agents: spot prices for your tokens, full market data (market cap, 24h volume, supply, 24h change) for the lead token, top-10 chains by TVL, and the best yield pools by APY. Prices, market, TVL and yields together — the most complete crypto+DeFi call per request.

intents.name: get_screen_entity
intents.description: Sanctions screening for compliance, AML, KYC and KYB agents: use before onboarding, paying or contracting with a person or organization. Fuzzy-matches the name against the official OFAC SDN list and the UN Security Council consolidated list, aliases included, and returns scored matches with list, sanctions program, entity type and source reference. Diacritic- and case-insensitive, tunable min_score (default 0.6). One keyless USDC call.

intents.name: get_sec_resolve
intents.description: Resolve a US public company's SEC EDGAR CIK for AI agents and financial bots. Look up by stock ticker (AAPL, NVDA, MSFT) or by company name and get the zero-padded 10-digit CIK identifier, ticker, and official registrant title. The keyless first step before any SEC filings or XBRL financial-facts query. Unified schema, stablecoin-payable.

intents.name: get_sec_filings
intents.description: Recent SEC EDGAR filings for any US public company, for AI agents and research bots. Query by stock ticker or CIK, optionally filter by form type (10-K, 10-Q, 8-K), and get each filing's form, filing date, accession number, primary document and a direct SEC Archives URL. Sourced from SEC EDGAR submissions — keyless, unified schema.

intents.name: get_sec_facts
intents.description: XBRL company financial facts from SEC EDGAR for AI agents and fundamental-analysis bots. Query by stock ticker or CIK for reported us-gaap concepts — revenues, net income, assets, liabilities, EPS and more — each with its latest value, unit, fiscal year and period, form and period-end date. Optionally filter to one concept. Keyless, USD, unified schema.

intents.name: get_geo_forward
intents.description: Forward geocoding for AI agents: turn a place name or address into coordinates. Returns the best-match latitude, longitude, country and ISO country code, administrative regions (admin1/admin2), population, IANA timezone and GeoNames feature code. Query by q= or address=. Sourced from Open-Meteo geocoding — keyless, unified schema, stablecoin-payable.

intents.name: get_geo_reverse
intents.description: Reverse geocoding for AI agents: turn a latitude/longitude into a human-readable address. Returns city, locality, principal subdivision (state/region), country and ISO country code for the given coordinates. Query by lat= and lon=. Sourced from BigDataCloud — keyless, unified schema, stablecoin-payable.

intents.name: get_geo_places
intents.description: Place search / geocoding autocomplete for AI agents: return the top matching places for a name query. Each result carries name, latitude, longitude, country and ISO code, administrative regions, population, timezone and feature code. Query by q= with an optional count= (1-20, default 5). Sourced from Open-Meteo geocoding — keyless, unified schema.

Optional max_input_tokens lets you cap the input tokens used for pricing; if the message is longer than this cap the server returns an error instead of under-pricing. Optional action=message (or omitting action) performs a direct GPT call with the given message. Optional action=create creates a custom agent with the given message as preprompt for 0.001 USDC (no OpenAI call), stores a base_price_usdc using (max_input_tokens_for_agent or 1000) + preprompt + max_output_tokens, and returns a custom_id. Optional action=list lists up to 100 recent custom agents for the paying wallet for 0.001 USDC without calling OpenAI. Custom agents can be called via POST /base/llm/gpt with custom_id, or POST /base/llm/gpt/{custom_id}. Each custom agent has a fixed price per call based on its stored preprompt, model, max_output_tokens and max_input_tokens; if the runtime message is longer than max_input_tokens the server returns an error.
